english.title: Construct a cellar / room below subsoil water level without consent
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) constructed a

(A)_[cellar]_
(B)_[room]_

(C)_[in]_
(D)_[as part of]_

(E)_[a house]
(F)_[a shop]_
(G)_[an inn]_
(H)_[an hotel]_
(I)_[an office]_

at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) when the floor level of the

(J)_[cellar]_
(K)_[room]_

was lower than the ordinary level of the subsoil water on, under or adjacent to the site of the

(L)_[house]_
(M)_[shop]_
(N)_[inn]_
(O)_[hotel]_
(P)_[office]_

(Q)_[without the consent of the local authority]_
(R)_[in contravention of a condition, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITION..), attached to a consent under section 74 of the Building Act 1984]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 74(3) of the Building Act 1984.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
constructed a cellar / room
in / as part of a house / shop / inn / hotel / office
floor level of the cellar / room
is lower than the ordinary level of the subsoil water
on / under / adjacent to the site
of the house / shop / inn / hotel / office
without consent of local authority or in contravention of a condition attached to a consent under s.74

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence does not apply to the construction of a cellar or room in connection with a shop, inn, hotel or office that forms part of a railway station.
